searchText: could anyone tell me why whisper is not used widely now? I'd look into vacp2p (research group that works with Status) and waku (messaging protocol they designed). there were fundamental issues with the whisper design that vacp2p has tried to design around for peer to peer comms https://our.status.im/peer-to-peer-messaging-where-whisper-falls-short-and-waku-picks-up/ and https://vac.dev/waku-v2-update address this question <@!548729752748294164> thanks <@420951281910284289> and <@654267572107083777> , I'll look through it now!
